items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Peter Lacasse is a good man.

ctx.x: Did you ever think of the name of that trumpet player he forgot?

He was still alive but he was. Peter Lacasse. Oh, Peter Lacasse. He's a good type of player. Red was a tough man. Who was he playing with? Oh, he had his own orchestra. Then he used to play with the Tuxedo Band. Played with Exorcist, Street Band, all the bands. You know? Peter Lacasse is a good man. They had some wonderful trumpet players in the yard.
What about drummers when you were young? Do they have any good drummers there?
